structure.segA: [u16 constant 0x41C3 LE (16835)][u16 varying] — constant tag + per-record variant/index field (top values: 21, 60, 56, 51, 61 occurrences).
structure.segB: 116 bytes; first 4 bytes parse as BIG-endian f32 with a small vocabulary (0.5000, 0.5002, 1.5000, 1.5004, 1.5062 — top 5 cover 376/661 records) — candidate playback-rate/blend field; bytes 4..12 constant across sampled records (f1331500 14ff5301) — candidate set hash/magic. Remainder of segB undecoded.
structure.segC: [u32 track_count][u16 track_ids x track_count] for 652/661 records (first-u32 < 1000); 647 with count 1..60, plus counts 64/67/69/72 (full-body motions); 367 of the 1..60 set end with a 0 terminator id. 9 records are float-led variants (first 4 bytes = BE f32 key data, e.g. 0x3f6b851f, 0x3f000000) — no directory, variant encoding. Track-id lists are increasing/sparse (e.g. rec0 [1,3,4,7,9,0], rec2 [6,8,12,13,14,16,22,24,30,32,34,36,37,53,61100*]). *rec2 trailing 61100 breaks the increasing pattern — open anomaly, possibly a flags word.
structure.segD: u16 index sequence starting 0,1,2,...,12 then jumping (e.g. to 95) and continuing — 150..156 entries; candidate bone/channel remap table for the record. Undecoded beyond shape.
